successCriteria.description: src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts exports a LeaveRequest entity whose fields are exactly: id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason (string|undefined), status (LeaveRequestStatus), approvedBy, approvedAt, rejectedBy, rejectedAt, rejectionReason, cancelledBy, cancelledAt, createdAt, updatedAt — no additional fields.
leave.model.ts exports a single shared helper countLeaveDays(startDate, endDate) that returns endDate - startDate + 1 (calendar days, inclusive of both ends, no weekend/holiday exclusion).
leave.model.ts declares the ILeaveRequestRepository and ILeaveService interfaces (method signatures only, no implementations).

src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts exports PgLeaveRequestRepository implementing ILeaveRequestRepository, with every method accepting an optional PoolClient as its LAST parameter and defaulting to the shared pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts when omitted.

The LeaveRequest entity's status field is typed as the shared LeaveRequestStatus imported from src/shared/types/ (not a locally redeclared literal), and the module compiles under strict TypeScript (tsc --noEmit) with no implicit any.

PgLeaveRequestRepository maps snake_case DB rows (leave_requests table) to the camelCase LeaveRequest entity, including the nullable approvedBy/approvedAt/rejectedBy/rejectedAt/rejectionReason/cancelledBy/cancelledAt columns.

constraints: countLeaveDays is the ONLY day-count implementation in the codebase — no call site (including future service code) may re-derive the count inline; it must be imported from the leave module.
All database access goes through the repository layer (GP-001) — PgLeaveRequestRepository uses parameterized SQL via the shared pool/client; no inline SQL in models or elsewhere.
Import every shared type from src/shared/types/ (its public entry point), never from a generic or internal location; the LeaveRequestStatus type must be the shared one.
Use unknown with type guards instead of any (HARNESS no-any rule); strict null checks apply.
Do NOT create the service, controller, routes, app registration, or tests in this sub-phase — those belong to sibling sub-phases 4b and 4c.
outOfScope: src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts (LeaveService orchestration of submit/approve/reject/cancel, sufficiency/overlap checks, transaction wiring) — Phase 4b.
src/modules/leave/leave.controller.ts, leave.routes.ts, and src/app.ts route registration — Phase 4b.
Any balance counter mutation, sufficiency/overlap enforcement, audit writes, or notification fanout — these are service-layer (Phase 4b) responsibilities, not model/repository concerns.

ambiguities.description: Whether the leave module ships an index.ts barrel in this sub-phase (the architecture's module-boundary rule requires imports through a public entry point, but the phase spec lists only leave.model.ts and leave.repository.ts).
options: Ship index.ts barrel re-exporting the entity, interfaces, countLeaveDays, and PgLeaveRequestRepository (consistent with all prior modules)
No barrel in this sub-phase; add it in Phase 4b when the service/controller/routes are created

ambiguities.description: The exact method set of ILeaveRequestRepository (e.g. whether it exposes a findByEmployeeAndDateRange or findApprovedOverlapping query for overlap detection, vs. leaving overlap filtering to the service).
options: Repository exposes a dedicated overlap query (findApprovedOverlapping) so the service can enforce overlap at approval
Repository exposes only generic create/update/findById/findByEmployee and the service filters in memory

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED; the status field is the shared LeaveRequestStatus union. The approval/rejection/cancellation actor+timestamp fields (approvedBy/approvedAt, rejectedBy/rejectedAt/rejectionReason, cancelledBy/cancelledAt) are null until the corresponding transition occurs, and are mutually exclusive with each other (only the set matching the current status is populated).
startDate and endDate are Dates with startDate <= endDate; the request's duration is always computed via countLeaveDays (calendar days inclusive of both ends), never re-derived inline.

The single shared day-count helper: returns endDate - startDate + 1 calendar days, inclusive of both ends, with no weekend/holiday exclusion. It is the only day-count implementation; every call site imports it.

interfaceConstraints.operation: ILeaveRequestRepository — persistence operations for LeaveRequest (create/update/read by id and by employee, and any query needed for overlap detection).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Reads return the entity or null/empty when absent; writes return the persisted entity. No business validation or balance/audit side effects belong here — repository is persistence-only.

interfaceConstraints.operation: ILeaveService — the leave lifecycle operations (submit/approve/reject/cancel) that the orchestrator will implement.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: State-changing operations must eventually write an audit record (GP-002) and run status + balance + audit through one unit-of-work client in one transaction; negative guards live only in BalanceService, never duplicated here.
Pure, deterministic function of its two Date arguments; returns an integer >= 1 for valid ranges.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The LeaveRequest.status field must reuse the shared LeaveRequestStatus type (const object + string-literal union) exactly as declared, with members DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED — do not redeclare a local literal.
The repository's optional-client pattern must match the leaf repositories: every method takes an optional PoolClient as its LAST parameter and defaults to the shared pool when omitted.
The repository must use the shared pool export (not a new Pool instance) and the snake_case→camelCase mapRow convention with unknown-style type guards.

The LeaveRequest entity shape must match the reconciled architecture's LeaveRequest attributes (id, employeeId, leaveTypeId, startDate, endDate, reason, status, approvedBy/At, rejectedBy/At/rejectionReason, cancelledBy/At, createdAt, updatedAt) and the leave_requests conceptual table columns.

integrationPoints.why: LeaveRequestStatus type for the status field; shared error types are available for the service (Phase 4b) to throw.
Shared pg pool used as the default executor when no client is passed to repository methods.
The leave service (Phase 4b) will call BalanceService with the day count n computed by countLeaveDays; the repository's optional-client pattern is the template for PgLeaveRequestRepository.
